logline: A new general manager with no baseball background is hired to rebuild a last-place professional baseball team during the off-season, clashing with entrenched culture to engineer an unlikely turnaround.

renewal.note: 16-episode limited run concluded February 14, 2020. Won Best Drama at the 56th Baeksang Arts Awards. No sequel produced.

bollymeter.basis: Winner of Best Drama at the 56th Baeksang Arts Awards and Namkoong Min's first Grand Prize at the SBS Drama Awards. Critics and viewers praised it as one of the finest sports dramas in Korean television, with viewership climbing from low single digits to nearly 20% in Seoul by the finale.

pull_quotes.text: Hot Stove League did not merely rely on being a sports drama to lure viewers.

seasons.review_body: Hot Stove League is the rare sports drama that earns its acclaim entirely in the boardroom, not on the field. The baseball season is over when the show begins - the drama unfolds in the off-season rebuild, through contract negotiations, scouting decisions, and organisational culture fights. Namkoong Min's Baek Seung-soo is a General Manager who plays by logic rather than sentiment, and the show treats his methods with the same rigour a legal procedural applies to case law. Park Eun-bin as operations manager Lee Se-young is equally sharp. Viewership grew dramatically across its 16-episode run, reaching nearly 20 percent in Seoul for the finale, and the Baeksang Best Drama win validated what audiences had already decided: this is one of the most tightly written Korean dramas of the 2019-2020 season.

episode_reviews.title: Episode 1
episode_reviews.spoiler_free: The premiere establishes the stakes with impressive economy - a team that has finished last four years running, a front office resistant to change, and a new GM hired specifically to be the outsider willing to break things. The boardroom tension is established before the first commercial break.
episode_reviews.the_moment: Baek Seung-soo's first meeting with the Dreams management sets the show's tone - analytical precision versus institutional inertia, played with no sentimentality.
